scripts.verify: bun run typecheck && bun run typecheck:dashboard && bun run test:default
scripts.verify:full: bun run typecheck && bun run typecheck:dashboard && bun run test:all
scripts.build:dashboard: bun build web/dashboard/settings.ts web/dashboard/api-fetch.ts web/dashboard/nav-rail.ts web/dashboard/ui/badges.ts web/dashboard/ui/theme-switch.ts web/dashboard/dashboard-entry.ts web/dashboard/ingest-submission.ts --outdir web/dashboard --target browser --format esm && bun build web/dashboard/graph/graph-entry.ts --outdir web/dashboard/graph --target browser --format esm
scripts.build:dashboard:dev: bun build web/dashboard/settings.ts web/dashboard/api-fetch.ts web/dashboard/nav-rail.ts web/dashboard/ui/badges.ts web/dashboard/ui/theme-switch.ts web/dashboard/dashboard-entry.ts web/dashboard/ingest-submission.ts --outdir web/dashboard --target browser --format esm --sourcemap=inline && bun build web/dashboard/graph/graph-entry.ts --outdir web/dashboard/graph --target browser --format esm --sourcemap=inline
